title: Cure for Death
author: Ingrid Wolf
description:
What if the technology to make everyone forever young and immortal is already around? We just don't know about it as it is top secret.

In this gender-neutral choice-based story, you have an opportunity to tell the truth to the world as a lab assistant to the scientist who created the immortality pill. Can you figure out the right thing to do?

The game uses no visuals or sounds, only plain text. Five different endings possible.

A winner of Philosophy Game Jam #2 on itch.io
